name: Novoray Corporation
summary: Novoray Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of functional filler and silicon micro powder products in China and internationally. The company offers crystalline silica powder, fused silica powder, soft composite silica powder, round corner crystalline silica powder, spherical silica powder, spherical aluminum oxide powder, sub-micron spherical silica powder, and acicular powder.
